question: Which chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa concludes with this colophon?
premises: The colophon names the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text.
It identifies the chapter on entablature characteristics.
It states the chapter number as eighteen.
inference: This marks the end of the eighteenth chapter on entablature characteristics.
plain_english: Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, on the characteristics of the entablature, in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
